titleAr: ملفات المنتجات لجوجل وميتا وتيك توك
titleEn: Product catalogue feeds for Google Merchant, Meta Catalog, TikTok

ar: ازاي ارفع منتجاتي على اعلانات فيسبوك؟
en: Do you have a Google Shopping / Meta catalogue feed?

steps: Merchant opens Product feeds, copies the Google Merchant / Meta Catalog / TikTok link (public /feeds/google.xml, /feeds/meta.xml, /feeds/tiktok.csv), and reads the feed health report of what is left out and why.
edgeCases: Mobile: admin pages are responsive; Arabic/RTL: numbers and mixed Arabic/English text must render correctly (Arabic-Indic digits normalised on input)
Plan/feature not allowing it: API returns 403 FEATURE_DISABLED with an upgrade target when the plan is the cause; assistant must name the plan and link Billing, never imply a toggle
gaps: Not merged yet (in PR); the public feed files are not capability api rows (public routes are outside coverage)
